# Matter Wall AI Admin

SQL-backed client-matter validation and ethical walls middleware with an administrator dashboard and optional Ollama AI assistant.

## What It Does

- Validates whether a user can open or work on a client/matter.
- Checks ethical wall access before downstream systems expose matter data.
- Provides admin CRUD screens over the SQL tables.
- Uses Ollama locally to help administrators summarize wall risks and draft remediation steps.

## Architecture

- `FastAPI` backend
- `SQLite` default SQL database
- Plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript admin dashboard served by the API
- Optional Ollama integration at `http://localhost:11434`

## Quick Start

```powershell
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -e .[dev]
matter-wall seed
matter-wall serve
```

Open:

```text
http://127.0.0.1:8080
```

## Middleware APIs

Client-matter validation:

```http
POST /api/middleware/client-matter/validate
```

Ethical wall check:

```http
POST /api/middleware/ethical-walls/check
```

See [docs/IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md](docs/IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md) for SQL schema, API examples, dashboard workflows, and implementation notes.
